Users who are accustomed to quickly searching images with ChatGPT can now use a new gesture to add photos to conversations even faster. Here's how.

ChatGPT makes it easier to attach recently taken photos to conversations

Although iOS's Visual Intelligence feature has been around for nearly two years, it remains limited to newer iPhone models and isn't available in every region.

For users who rely on ChatGPT for similar visual searches, attaching photos previously required tapping the "+" button, then "Photos," and selecting an image from the album.

While this process wasn't too cumbersome, OpenAI added a convenient gesture this week that makes adding recent photos to conversations a bit faster.

According to OpenAI's Adam Fry on X, users can now long-press the "+" button on the left side of the prompt box to bring up the four most recent photos.

They can then select one of these four photos to attach to the conversation, and then ask questions or use it as part of their prompt.

This new gesture was rolled out alongside several other ChatGPT improvements this week, including more accurate awareness of the current time, faster loading and performance for long conversations on the web version, and clearer interface prompts when users are waiting for a network connection.

Do you use AI for visual searches? Feel free to share in the comments.
